name: Yanvarsky smog
source:
All events happen to a typical, practically useless, groveling guy named Maxim. The protagonist lives in a practically godforsaken town, where only melancholy and a never-ending blizzard lurk.

Maxim is an ordinary and unremarkable guy working as a furniture deliveryman. He is constantly teased at his unloved job (just like always with loser protagonists), but one day he delivers another order and meets Viola, who changes his life so radically that it's hard to even imagine.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3794186411]Steam[/url]]
translation:
所有事件都发生在名叫马克西姆的青年身上——他是个典型的废柴，懦弱卑微、几乎一无是处。这位男主角住在一座近乎被上帝遗忘的偏僻小镇里，四周唯有挥之不去的阴郁与永不停歇的暴风雪。

平庸不起眼的马克西姆平时靠送家具维持生计，在这份自己毫不喜欢的工作中成天遭人取笑（就像所有废柴男主角的常规待遇一样）。直到某天，他在派送又一单货物时邂逅了维奥拉，人生轨迹就此发生了难以想象的翻天覆地之变。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3794186411]Steam[/url]]
